articles.title: HomeKit Weekly: Why the Eve Weather sensor is a must-have for Apple Home automations in 2026
articles.summary: Local weather is one of the most underrated variables to use in your Apple Home automation setup. Eve Weather has been part of my setup for a while now, and with its Matter upgrade a few years ago, it is incredibly useful in my home.

articles.title: Will price hikes force Apple to stop dragging its feet on certain product upgrades?
articles.summary: Earlier this summer, Apple dramatically increased its prices as a result of the ongoing memory crisis around the globe. Things like iPad Air increased from $599 to $749, M5 MacBook Pro from $1699 to $1999, and Apple TV from $129 to $199. That’s just a few examples, but the point is, these price hikes are steep. It leaves the question – will Apple work on major improvements to make its products more appealing at these new prices?
